data.why: The repo ships realistic bundled CSV fixtures for QC, chromosomal-aberration (CA), and mutation-matrix reports that exactly match the columns the default paplot.cfg template expects, so the CLI can render fully-populated interactive reports without any synthetic data.

goals: Inspect per-sample sequencing QC (average depth, read length, mapped/total reads, depth-coverage ratios) and spot samples with low coverage or poor mapping
Browse the chromosomal aberration (structural variant) report to find translocations, deletions, inversions and duplications affecting specific genes or chromosomes
Explore the gene-by-sample mutation matrix, sorting and filtering by mutation type (exonic, intronic, UTR, intergenic, downstream) and gene
Hover over matrix cells and bars to read per-variant tooltips (sample, gene, chromosome, position, ref/alt) without re-running any plotting tool
Use the generated index.html as a dashboard to jump between the QC, CA, and mutation sub-reports for the same demo project

review.summary: The tree describes paplot's three built reports faithfully and at a sensible grain, with accurate specific labels, and the second agent replayed every task and feature. But it misses the CA report's thumbnail-to-detail circos window, which carries the per-event breakpoint and gene tooltips the tree wrongly says don't exist, so it needs that task, the matching feature, and a few label fixes before filing.
